en: "I can really have it?{w}Now I can keep running the tavern without worrying. Thank you!!"{w}
note: Yes branch of the 2932 hand-in prompt.

en: "Still, I'm impressed you managed to get one.{w}Huh? I wasn't supposed to make any noise!?"{w}
note: The party tells her the Silent Beast hates noise; Berte reacts.

en: "Ahh... So that's why it hated us..."{w}{p}"...Or rather, from its side, it must've been like we were harassing it... Boo hoo."{w}
note: atashira = 'us': Berte and whoever went with her (the drinking parties, songs and dances of 2927). tohoho = 'Boo hoo'. 'it' = the Silent Beast.

en: "I did a bad thing there.{w}When I get some free time, maybe I'll bring it some food -- not as an adventurer, but as a tavern keeper..."{w}
"Whaaat, you won't give it to me? What's that supposed to mean... Cheapskate!!"{w}
note: No branch of the 2932 prompt.

en: "Welcome. Ahaha, you've got that 'I'm starviiing' look on your face!{w}The usual? Have a seat and wait!"{w}
note: Plain irasshai = 'Welcome.' (2888's drawn-out version was 'Welcome iiin!').

en: You gained 1 Fame!
You gained 2 Fame!
You gained 3 Fame!
You gained 4 Fame!
You gained {0B:0003:000F} Fame!
note: {0B} is the number insert.

en: Please form a party at the tavern.{w}
note: System message (no speaker).

en: "Hello!"{w}{p}"You've all come at just the right time! The renovation of the Alchemy Storage has just been finished.{w}Well, I say Alchemy Storage, but it's really the stables."{w}{p}"It doesn't look all that different, but you can put things in the space that's opened up,{w}so please, go ahead and use it!"{w}
note: New term: renkin souko = 'Alchemy Storage' (Elminage III glossary spelling). The storage is housed in the stables. The second-page sentence runs across a {w}; English is cut at the same point.

en: {0E}       *  You can now store up to 30 items  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner; centring with leading ASCII spaces is a guess (same method as slice 009 row 2884) -- check in game.

en: "Welcome ho...{w}Oops, I mean, welcome to the inn!"{w}
note: okae... = she starts 'okaerinasai' (welcome home), as if to family, then switches to the shop greeting irasshaimase.

en: "I've just had the Alchemy Storage expanded.{w}That'll make the Alchemy Storage even easier to use!"{w}
{0E}       *  You can now store up to 50 items  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "...Still, though.{w}The stables and the storage have finally ended up bigger than the inn itself."{w}{p}"I feel like the shop Mom and Dad left me keeps evolving further and further in the wrong direction for an inn..."{w}{p}"Mom, Dad, up in heaven...{w}Is your Rosetta going to end up a horse owner or something?"{w}
note: Self-reference by name to her late parents kept as 'your Rosetta' (as in slice 009 row 2805). bashu = horse owner.

en: "Everyone! I've been waiting for you!{w}Look at it, this huge Alchemy Storage!! Every bit of open ground has been turned into storage!"{w}
{0E}       *  You can now store up to 99 items  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "...So now, at Rosetta's Inn, the inn and the stables-and-storage have completely traded places..."{w}{p}"...You'll take responsibility for this, won't you?{w}You'd better go out there and do great things, or I won't be happy, okay?"{w}
note: Rosetta's Inn = glossary name. iya desu yo = 'I won't be happy'; teasing, she retracts it in 2970.

en: "Just kidding! Nope, nope, it was a joke!"{w}{p}"I'm sure Mom and Dad up in heaven are glad, too, that I can be of help to you all."{w}
note: Subject of otetsudai ga dekite is unstated; read as Rosetta (her inn) helping the party.

en: "Good luck on your adventures.{w}Whenever you're tired, come and stay with us anytime!"{w}
"Welcome!{w}Oh, could it be this is your first time here?"{w}{p}"This is Rosetta's Inn.{w}And my name is Rosetta, too! I hope you'll be good to both me and the inn!"{w}

"How was the journey to Bistel? Aren't you tired?{w}You can't move the way you want to when your body's worn out, you know!"{w}{p}"We've got nice fluffy beds ready for all you adventurers. Don't be shy -- please stay the night!"{w}
"Hello!{w}It's another lovely day, perfect for adventuring!"{w}{p}"I'll have the meals and the bedding all ready to blow your fatigue away, so go off on your adventure without a care!"{w}

"This inn has a bath, you know. Did you know that? A b-a-t-h~"{w}{p}"An adventurer from the East told me about it. Here, believe it or not, we do our bathing with hot water!"{w}{p}"Unlike a cold-water wash, it loosens up your stiff muscles too, so the guests who've stayed here say great things about it."{w}{p}"Guests in any room can use it, so please do...{w}Huh? Can stable guests... use it too...?"{w}
note: The music note becomes '~'. o-fu-ro spelled out as 'b-a-t-h'. mizuabi = washing in (cold) water; the inn uses hot water. The last line echoes the party's question.

en: "Hmmph...{w}In that case, come on, stay in one of the paid rooms~{w}We are a business too, you know, sort of."{w}{p}"A-and besides! If you only ever stay in the stables, you'll end up only able to eat straw and stuff!?"{w}{p}"You might wake up one day and find you've turned into a horse! Neigh, just like that!{w}...Well, I'm only kidding."{w}
note: Answer to 2982: stable guests. mu- = pouty 'Hmmph'. ichiou = 'sort of'. hihi-n = horse whinny 'Neigh'.

en: "Where are you all from? I've never been outside Bistel, so Bistel cooking is all I know."{w}{p}"I'd be happy if the food we serve here suits your taste..."{w}
"Hmmph...{w}Come and eat the dinner I make once in a while, won't you... It's delicious, too."{w}
note: oishii noni = 'even though it's delicious' -- a sulky afterthought.

en: "Wel...come..."{w}
note: Dejected irasshai...mase; start of the empty-register scene.

en: "What am I going to do..."{w}
Rosetta is staring sadly at the guest register...{w}
Speak to her?
note: Yes/No prompt. 'her' = Rosetta (glossary: female).

en: The guest register Rosetta hurriedly tried to hide had hardly any guests' names in it.{w}

"Sorry... You caught me at a bad moment..."{w}{p}"I lost my parents when I was little... This inn is what Mom and Dad left me."{w}{p}"So I really want to keep it going somehow... but hardly any guests come in...{w}Oh, it's not your fault, okay!?"{w}{p}"W-well, sure... I do wish you'd stay in a regular room instead of the stables... I really do wish that, you know!?"{w}{p}"Traveling merchants and the like used to stay here all the time.{w}That was my main income, but..."{w}{p}"Lately Highberry Forest has gotten really dangerous, and fewer people come through."{w}{p}"Apparently some monster called Taranti has been tangling with travelers..."{w}{p}"I know 'tangling' sounds like a weird way to put it, but everyone who's run into Taranti says, 'I got all tangled up...'{w}What could that mean?"{w}
note: karamu = pester/harass and also entangle (Taranti is a spider): 'tangle with' / 'got all tangled up' keeps both senses. Rosetta does not know what Taranti is, so no pronoun; name repeated. Highberry Forest, Taranti = glossary.

en: "Sigh...{w}At this rate, the inn really is going to go under... What should I do..."{w}

"Um, I heard that Taranti in Highberry has calmed down...{w}Could it be that you all...!?"{w}{p}"Ever since that rumor spread, we've been getting more guests again, just like the old days!!"{w}{p}"Thank you, thank you so much!{w}You're this inn's saviors!!"{w}

"I don't know how I can ever thank you all...{w}I know!"{w}{p}"You use the Alchemy Storage, right?{w}I've been charging a fee for it until now, but from now on, please use it for free!"{w}{p}"If you all do well, I think other people will be happy too.{w}It's the least I can do to thank you."{w}
{0E}           *  Storage fee is now 0 GP  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner; centring is a guess. GP per batch-1 convention.

en: "Welcome hom-- Oh, I'm sorry!{w}You've stayed with us so much that I've started to think of you like family..."{w}{p}"If there's anything you'd like, just say the word.{w}I'll do my very best to look after you!"{w}
note: okaerina... = cut-off 'welcome home', as in 2958.

en: "Thanks for all your hard work!{w}What kind of adventure did you have today?{w}What kind of monsters did you fight?"{w}{p}"I'll come and scrub your backs later, so if you don't mind, tell me all about it!"{w}
note: osenaka nagashi ni = come to wash the guests' backs in the bath; kept literal.

en: "Thanks to all of you, this inn has managed to get back on its feet.{w}Thank you, really!"{w}{p}"I don't know if it counts as thanks, but I'm going to make this inn even more comfortable, so I hope you'll keep coming back!"{w}
"Yes, yes! The stables again, right!{w}That's fine, I get it!"{w}{p}"Lately I feel like I spend more time laying down straw than chopping vegetables.{w}Whose fault could that be!? ...Hmmph."{w}
As you lay down on the bed, a strange floating sensation enveloped you.{w}And then...{w}
note: Narration; the party is 'you'.

en: "...ive...back...{w}Give it back... my... umbrella...{w}...I'm TELLING you to give it baaack!!"{w}
note: Unseen speaker in a dream. kasa read as umbrella: glossary has Lukoje (an umbrella-carrying dream girl), probably this voice; not confirmed here. The opening fragments are pieces of kaeshite.

en: "...Ah, it's you lot.{w}I bought this book from a traveling merchant from Isfald.{w}It's called the Great History of Hestrio, apparently."{w}{p}"Word is it was obtained in Baroque Fort, where all those ruffians hang about.{w}It even records ancient history that I didn't know about."{w}{p}"I'll put it on display for now, so buy it if it suits you."{w}
note: Isfald, Baroque Fort, Great History of Hestrio = glossary. omaetachi = 'you lot' (Costo's gruff register).

en: {0E}    *  Great History of Hestrio now in stock  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "Heh heh heh.{w}Thanks to you lot bringing in good items to sell, my shop's reputation keeps getting better and better."{w}{p}"Well, it's not as if I'm grateful or anything, but as a special favor, I'll raise the prices I pay a little."{w}
{0E}         *  Shop now pays more for items  *{0F}{w}
note: kaitori kakaku = the price the shop pays the player for items. System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "Hmm... What on earth is this thing?"{w}{p}"Seems I bought it without realizing, but the writing is different every time I look at it.{w}...Creepy."{w}{p}"You lot, if you want it, hurry up and buy it.{w}I don't care for strange items like this."{w}
{0E}      *  Book of the Next Age now in stock  *{0F}{w}
note: New name: jidai no sho = 'Book of the Next Age' (Elminage III glossary spelling). System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "Those Saimar folks, you know.{w}My shop has such a good selection, they came to negotiate a special deal!"{w}
note: Saimar = glossary (a port town); the Saimar merchants.

en: "The rascals were shocked when they saw my face!{w}They came expecting a merely skilled shopkeeper, and it turned out I was a minister!"{w}
note: daijin = minister; Costo boasting about his government rank.

en: "Keep putting your backs into collecting items. In return, I'll buy from you lot at even better prices."{w}
{0E}      *  Shop now pays much more for items  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "The other day, the library people came rushing in, white as sheets.{w}Listen and be amazed! ...Every item in this land has ended up gathered in this very shop, they said!"{w}{p}"So they left this thing behind."{w}
note: toshokan no renchuu: which library is not stated (possibly Elminage, the gods' library). kessou wo kaete = agitated, pale.

en: {0E}   *  Encyclopedia of All Things now in stock  *{0F}{w}
note: New name: banbutsu hyakka jiten = 'Encyclopedia of All Things'. System banner; centring is a guess.

en: "I don't know how much it's worth, but seeing things through to the end is what matters.{w}You lot did very well!!"{w}
Idiot Costo
note: Name box; glossary.

en: "Y-you! That thing you've got there! Isn't that Lady Ragnastia's blanket...!!{w}...No, wait, it reeks, so keep it away from me."{w}{p}"Sorry, but could you take it to Lady Ragnastia?{w}I'll be right behind you!!"{w}
note: Lady Ragnastia as in slice 008. The blanket = the Dirty Blanket item (glossary).

en: "It's probably not anywhere anymore, but... if you find it thrown out somewhere, could you bring it to Lady Ragnastia?"{w}

"How did it come to this..."{w}{p}"Ah, it's you lot...{w}Would you hear me out for a moment?"{w}{p}"After you resolved the Contrachio incident, I rode on the coattails of your success and was allowed to return to the Administration Bureau."{w}{p}"I went back to the castle and started working as the Queen's right hand, but..."{w}
note: Leads into a flashback (3059-3087, speaker box 'Costo'). okobore = scraps of the party's success; 'rode on the coattails'.

en: "And while I was getting back to official duties, I did a big cleanup too! Farewell to my accursed past! Ahh, I feel great! Bwahahahaha!"{w}
note: Flashback.

en: Ragnastia
note: Name box; glossary.

en: "Costo...{w}Have you seen my blanket?"{w}
"Eh? Your blanket, Lady Ragnastia?{w}How would I know anything about a thing like that?"{w}
note: Costo uses her name as a polite second person; 'Your blanket, Lady Ragnastia'.

en: "No... of course you wouldn't.{w}I heard you'd been doing all sorts of cleaning, Costo, so I thought it might have gotten mixed in with something..."{w}
note: Ragnastia addresses him by name; English 'you' plus a vocative.

en: "Ah, so that's what this is about.{w}But I haven't laid eyes on any of your things, Lady Ragnastia."{w}{p}"The only thing was a grubby old blanket with some weird embroidery lying in the corridor, which I picked up while I was at it."{w}
note: omeshimono = (her) clothes/belongings; 'any of your things'.

en: "Really!?{w}Where is that blanket?"{w}
"I told them to throw out that filthy, smelly blanket."{w}
"Wha--...{w}Th... Threw it ou...!?"{w}
note: e" = strangled 'Wha--'. sutet(a) written in katakana: stunned repetition.

en: "Yes.{w}
note: Opening fragment of the next row (no closing quote in the source either); keep identical to the first line of 3077.

en:
{0E}"Yes.{0F}
...Huh!? N-no way.{w}The blanket you're looking for, Lady Ragnastia...?"{w}
note: First line repeats 3075 between {0E}/{0F}; the \n after {0F} is kept (same pattern as slice 009 row 2859). He trails off as he realizes.

en: "The blanket I've kept by my side every moment since I was a child...{w}The cute blanket with the Emperor Bird embroidery...{w}My precious blanket, the one I can't sleep without... you..."{w}
note: The source ends on the object marker (taisetsu na moufu wo...), leaving the verb for 3081 (sutet(a)?). English ends on '... you...' so 3081 completes it. Emperor Bird = glossary.

en: "Threw it out?"{w}
note: Katakana sutet(a)? -- completes 3079.

en: "Ah, well... um..."{w}
" Y o u   t h r e w   i t   o u t ? "{w}
note: Source spells su-te-cha-tta-no with a space between every katakana for a menacing, robotic delivery; mirrored with spaced letters and inner padding.

en: "Ugh... Y-yes, I threw it out..."{w}
